calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT week_ending_date 
FROM fact_stock_week 
WHERE week_ending_date >= '2026-02-23' AND week_ending_date <= '2026-03-22'
ORDER BY week_ending_date

SELECT 
  p.category,
  AVG(s.closing_value) AS average_stock_value
FROM fact_stock_week s
INNER JOIN dim_store st ON s.store_key = st.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON s.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.week_ending_date >= '2026-02-23' 
  AND s.week_ending_date <= '2026-03-22'
  AND st.region = 'West'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.category,
  COUNT(*) as record_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.week_ending_date) as weeks,
  COUNT(DISTINCT st.store_id) as stores,
  MIN(s.closing_value) as min_value,
  MAX(s.closing_value) as max_value
FROM fact_stock_week s
INNER JOIN dim_store st ON s.store_key = st.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON s.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.week_ending_date >= '2026-02-23' 
  AND s.week_ending_date <= '2026-03-22'
  AND st.region = 'West'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category

FROM dim_date

SELECT 
  p.category,
  ROUND(AVG(s.closing_value), 2) AS average_stock_value
FROM fact_stock_week s
INNER JOIN dim_store st ON s.store_key = st.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON s.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.week_ending_date >= '2026-02-23' 
  AND s.week_ending_date <= '2026-03-22'
  AND st.region = 'West'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category
